role: Fixed eight-pair development estimate; no policy promotion

concurrencyAmendment.instruction: submit more worlds and get it done faster without doing anything else yet
concurrencyAmendment.note: The shared creation lock stays held until the original workers drain and are stopped; this controller creates sequentially within that lock. All outcomes append to the original inventory.

runnerDrain: Original runner stopped only after all eleven worlds it created completed. Continuation completed the other five. No active policy world was interrupted or repeated.
limitations: Practice seeds differ from ranked seeds. Leaderboard differences are descriptive benchmarks, not matched policy effects or predicted ranks.
Eight independent seed blocks are assumed for intervals; sixteen policy worlds do not double the sample size. Small samples cannot resolve unseen tails.
Candidate was selected on prior development data; this panel is estimation/development and cannot later be called untouched validation.
A failed or interrupted panel retains every planned case and does not support a complete-policy estimate.
decision: Retain control and candidate separately. Use this estimate to prioritize research; no promotion or ranking authorized.
